# Davonium Technologies

Davonium Technologies develops digital products for students and everyday users and practical websites and digital experiences for small businesses.

Preferred public domain: https://www.davoniumtech.com/

## Products
- Ready2Go Learning: learning and exam practice for JAMB candidates and students; in development. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/ready2go-learning
- Marvel Chat: communication product; initial build complete and active development continues. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/marvel-chat
- Davonium Nexus: project visibility and client handoff workspace; in development. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/davonium-nexus
